headlines.title: DNC sues administration over taxpayer-funded pro-Trump TV ads
headlines.description: Trump announced this week that he and his PAC, MAGA Inc., would pay for the ads moving forward following bipartisan criticism.

headlines.title: Florida poll: Republicans lead in the races for governor and Senate
headlines.description: The new survey shows the state’s Hispanic voters shifting away from President Donald Trump after Republicans made gains in 2024.

headlines.title: Republican John James seeks some distance from Trump in Michigan governor debate
headlines.description: Democrat Jocelyn Benson repeatedly tried to tie James, a Trump-backed congressman, to the president during their first showdown ahead of the November election.

headlines.title: Christa Pike's lawyers speak after emergency hearing: She woke up 'to the shock of everyone'
headlines.description: Christa Pike's attorneys, Luke Ihnen and Randy Spivey, discuss the ruling that Tennessee must preserve evidence from the failed execution, Pike's condition at the hospital and how they plan to proceed with her case.

headlines.title: Cornell students hold sit-in over alleged 2024 fraternity assault
headlines.description: Wednesday’s protest illustrates the tense mood on the Ivy League campus following Jane Doe’s civil lawsuit.

headlines.title: Israel Marks Three Years Since Oct. 7 Attacks With Remembrances
headlines.description: Israel is marking a somber milestone, three years since the Oct. 7 attacks, pausing to remember the deadliest day in its history. A moment of silence was held for the 1,200 killed and 251 kidnapped in the 2023 Hamas-led attack. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: The secret to a good night’s rest? Let sleeping dogs lie ... next to you
headlines.description: A surprising new study found that people who sleep near their dogs don’t experience disrupted sleep. If anything we humans are the ones disturbing our dogs’ sleep.

headlines.title: Live updates: The absolute best October Prime Day deals, hand-picked by a shopping reporter
headlines.description: NBC Selected editors are tracking the best October Prime Day deals on the final day of Amazon’s sale, with live updates on deals actually worth buying.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.

headlines.title: Trump wants to make his West Palm Beach golf club a permanent presidential retreat
headlines.description: The proposed deal would also make Trump’s club the “permanent United States Presidential Golf Course,” which could be used “by all past, current and future” presidents, the club’s attorney said in a letter.

headlines.title: Viral video of Arizona cheerleader slammed to ground by police and punched draws national outcry
headlines.description: National civil rights attorneys are questioning the “level of force” Tempe police used after they watched the video involving Arizona State cheerleader Eryn Bonner.
